title: Took vg-paradigms release 2026.10.14 by its auto subscription
body:
The dry run broke nothing: no rule it would newly break, no license it would block. What moved:
- + checks.flake: A project's checks are its flake's `checks` (build, lint, format, tests, cargo deny), so `nix flake check` runs all of them, before every push and on any builder; commits run the same tools incrementally in the dev shell. The checks' source includes every file the tests read, and no test fetches anything at run time. Benchmarks run in the dev shell, not as checks. Windows-native code, Vivado, and GPU or attached hardware are the named exceptions, run on a machine that has them.
- guidance changed
